title: Make tax rates injectable
body: compute_tax now takes the rate table as a parameter so regions can be configured per tenant.

edits.find:
def compute_tax(amount_cents: int, region: str) -> int:
    rate_bps = TAX_RATES_BPS.get(region, 0)
edits.replace:
def compute_tax(amount_cents: int, region: str, rates: dict[str, int]) -> int:
    rate_bps = rates.get(region, 0)
